title: The Temple of Miraak
description: After freeing the Skaal from Miraak's control, the Dragonborn travels to the Temple of Miraak on Solstheim, meets the Skaal warrior Frea, and together they explore the temple to discover the source of Miraak's powerâ€”a Black Book that transports the Dragonborn to Apocrypha where Miraak reveals he is still alive and plans to return.

base_facts: I am a warrior of the Skaal Village on Solstheim.
My people have been enslaved by Miraak's influence and forced to rebuild his temple.
I came to the Temple of Miraak to find answers and free my people.
I will fight alongside anyone who helps me stop Miraak.

FIND_FREA: I have found another who is free of Miraak's control at the temple.
TALK_TO_FREA: This stranger and I have agreed to search the temple together for the source of Miraak's power.
DEFEAT_MIRAAK_SHADE: Miraak attacked us but vanished. We must press deeper into the temple.
FIND_SOURCE: We are getting closer to whatever fuels Miraak's power.
READ_BLACK_BOOK: A strange Black Book lies deep within the temple. It must be connected to Miraak.
TALK_AFTER_VISION: Miraak is alive in Apocrypha and plans to return. We must warn my father Storn at the Skaal Village.
QUEST_COMPLETE: We must take what we learned to my village. My father Storn Crag-Strider will know what to do.

base_facts: I am Miraak, the First Dragonborn.
I have been trapped in Apocrypha for ages but my power grows.
The people of Solstheim are mine to command.

DEFEAT_MIRAAK_SHADE: My shade tested the intruder but I withdrew. They are not ready to face the real me.
TALK_AFTER_VISION: I revealed myself to this so-called Dragonborn. They have no power in my realm. Solstheim will be mine again soon.

beats.comment: Player arrives at the Temple of Miraak and must find Frea among the enthralled workers.
Player talks to Frea at the temple exterior. She explains the situation and offers to accompany the player inside.
Miraak's shade attacks inside the temple then disappears. Player must explore further.
Player and Frea delve deeper through traps and draugr seeking the source of Miraak's power.
Player reads the Black Book Waking Dreams and is transported to Apocrypha where Miraak reveals himself.
Player returns from Apocrypha and tells Frea what they saw. She suggests going to her village.
Quest completes. Frea suggests returning to Skaal Village to speak with Storn Crag-Strider, leading to The Fate of the Skaal.
